digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT), which is the stock default but not the admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit on instances where the limit has been raised or set to unlimited
comments longer than the hardcoded 32767 but within an instance's raised ceiling are silently truncated by rebar, resulting in permanent local/remote body divergence

rebar's DC comment sanitizer and fit_comment both depend on the description fitter function (fit_outbound) which uses ADF-based sizing inappropriate for comments and risks silent retargeting if description fitting changes
the application-properties endpoint is admin-only and inaccessible to rebar's non-admin PAT, so runtime discovery of the limit is not viable

configurability of the comment ceiling via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars defaulting to 32767 with range 0–2147483647 decouples comments from the description fitter and addresses data loss for operators who have raised or removed the limit
